extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Text-layer table (pdftotext -bbox) on a landscape page; cell geometry recovered from rule lines detected in a 200 dpi raster render (17 vertical rules → 16 physical columns; horizontal rules → row bands). One label column (column 1, 'Procedure'), so the first data column is position 2 and data columns run 2–15. Column 16 is the right-hand 'Comments' notes column: excluded from schedule_grid/activity_schedule and emitted as footnote annotations with synthesized markers n1–n12. The header band reprints on document page 11; it is de-duplicated and emitted once. No merged cells anywhere in the table body — every internal vertical rule is present in every body row band; the only merge is the header row-1 cell spanning columns 3–14.

table_metadata.table_purpose: Single anchor schedule of activities for the two-period crossover: screening, Periods 1 and 2 study days (D-1 through D36), and the early discontinuation visit.
table_metadata.notes: Only SoA grid in the excerpt. Document page 9 carries the section heading '2. Schedule of Activities' and no table. The grid runs across document pages 10 and 11 with the two header rows reprinted on page 11; treated as one table (page_start 10, page_end 11) with the reprinted header de-duplicated per prompt §1b, rather than as a parent plus a 'continuation' table.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band naming the major study phases across the timeline: 'Screening' over the screening column, a single merged cell 'Periods 1 and 2 Study Days – at least 35 days washout between Day 1 doses' spanning the on-study day columns (positions 3–14), and 'ED' (early discontinuation) over position 15. Classified 'epoch' because the values are major study phases (screening / treatment / early discontinuation) rather than named visits or day numbers. The label cell (column 1) of this band is empty in the source, so property_name was synthesized.

Second header band carrying protocol study days for each column: 'D-28 to D-2' (screening window), then D-1, D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6, D7, D8, D15, D21 and 'D36 (±1)'. Classified 'study_day' because every value is a protocol day (or day range/window) relative to Day 1 dosing. The label cell of this band reads 'Procedure', which heads the activity-name column rather than naming this row, so property_name was synthesized as 'Study Day'; the raw cell text is preserved in property_name_source.cell_value.

annotations.annotation_text: Specified times are approximate, and actual times will be recorded.  Actual sampling time should not exceed 1 hour prior to dosing for the predose sample.

Period 2, Day -1 procedures (pregnancy tests) and some Period 2, Predose procedures (physical examinations, medical assessments, and clinical laboratory assessments) may be omitted if Period 1, D36 (±1) procedure dates occur within 4 days of Period 2 dosing.  Period 2, Day 36 (±1) will also be considered as the final follow-up visit.
Within 7 to 14 days upon confirmation of early discontinuation.
Study drug will be administered after an overnight fast of at least 8 hours.
Subjects’ CRU stay may be extended at the investigator’s discretion for safety monitoring.
Physical examination at screening.  Thereafter, targeted reviews and medical assessments as appropriate.

Single safety ECG will be collected.  ECGs must be recorded before collecting any blood samples at each timepoint.  Subjects must be supine for approximately 5 to 10 minutes before ECG collection, and remain supine but awake during ECG collection.
Additional time points may be added, if warranted and agreed upon between Lilly and the investigator.
See Appendix 2 for details.  Day 1 predose sample is for baseline only.
Female subjects only.  Serum pregnancy test will be performed at screening and urine pregnancy tests at subsequent visits.
Female subjects considered to be postmenopausal only.  Women with confirmed nonchildbearing potential status can be exempted from further pregnancy tests during the study after screening.

Where applicable, collection times should match with PK sampling time points.  In the event of immediate or non-immediate drug hypersensitivity reactions, unscheduled samples will be collected as detailed in Section 9.4.6.  Subjects with TE ADA at follow-up/ED will undergo additional follow-up as detailed in Section 9.7.
Performed using a bedside glucose monitor.  Additional unscheduled measurements may be taken at the discretion of the investigator where clinically indicated.
Up to a 10% deviation from the nominal collection time is permissible as long as actual sampling time is recorded.

Note:  All sampling times are given relative to dosing (Time 0 hour) with tirzepatide (predose or hours postdose).  Unless otherwise indicated, predose procedure may be performed any time prior to dosing.

If multiple procedures take place at the same time point, the following order of the procedures should be used:  ECGs, vital signs, PK sample (record of actual PK sampling time is the priority), clinical laboratory sample, immunogenicity, blood glucose and pharmacogenetic sample.
